smartlingo_language_class_order_paid_at_.name: smartlingo_language_class_order_paid_at_ck
smartlingo_language_class_order_paid_at_.value:
(
    ("smartlingo_language_class_orders"."status" IN ('paid', 'refunded', 'partially_refunded', 'disputed') AND "smartlingo_language_class_orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("smartlingo_language_class_orders"."status" IN ('pending', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND "smartlingo_language_class_orders"."paid_at" IS NULL)
  )

smartlingo_path_unit_stage_sequence_ck.name: smartlingo_path_unit_stage_sequence_ck
smartlingo_path_unit_stage_sequence_ck.value: ("smartlingo_learning_path_units"."stage_id" = 'foundation' AND "smartlingo_learning_path_units"."sequence" BETWEEN 1 AND 3) OR ("smartlingo_learning_path_units"."stage_id" = 'everyday' AND "smartlingo_learning_path_units"."sequence" BETWEEN 4 AND 6) OR ("smartlingo_learning_path_units"."stage_id" = 'independent' AND "smartlingo_learning_path_units"."sequence" BETWEEN 7 AND 9)

smartlingo_path_unit_prerequisite_ck.name: smartlingo_path_unit_prerequisite_ck
smartlingo_path_unit_prerequisite_ck.value: ("smartlingo_learning_path_units"."sequence" = 1 AND "smartlingo_learning_path_units"."prerequisite_unit_id" IS NULL) OR ("smartlingo_learning_path_units"."sequence" > 1 AND "smartlingo_learning_path_units"."prerequisite_unit_id" IS NOT NULL)

smartlingo_placement_attempt_scores_ck.name: smartlingo_placement_attempt_scores_ck
smartlingo_placement_attempt_scores_ck.value:
("smartlingo_placement_attempts"."vocabulary_score" IS NULL OR "smartlingo_placement_attempts"."vocabulary_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    AND ("smartlingo_placement_attempts"."reading_score" IS NULL OR "smartlingo_placement_attempts"."reading_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    AND ("smartlingo_placement_attempts"."writing_score" IS NULL OR "smartlingo_placement_attempts"."writing_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    AND ("smartlingo_placement_attempts"."listening_score" IS NULL OR "smartlingo_placement_attempts"."listening_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    AND ("smartlingo_placement_attempts"."dialogue_score" IS NULL OR "smartlingo_placement_attempts"."dialogue_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
    AND ("smartlingo_placement_attempts"."overall_score" IS NULL OR "smartlingo_placement_attempts"."overall_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

smartlingo_class_access_exclusive_ck.name: smartlingo_class_access_exclusive_ck
smartlingo_class_access_exclusive_ck.value:
(
    ("smartlingo_class_access_grants"."method" = 'referral' AND "smartlingo_class_access_grants"."invite_id" IS NOT NULL AND "smartlingo_class_access_grants"."license_order_id" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("smartlingo_class_access_grants"."method" = 'license_key' AND "smartlingo_class_access_grants"."invite_id" IS NULL AND "smartlingo_class_access_grants"."license_order_id" IS NOT NULL)
  )

smartlingo_media_scope_ck.name: smartlingo_media_scope_ck
smartlingo_media_scope_ck.value:
(
    ("smartlingo_media_assets"."kind" IN ('avatar', 'voice_practice', 'certificate_asset') AND "smartlingo_media_assets"."scope_type" = 'user' AND "smartlingo_media_assets"."scope_id" = "smartlingo_media_assets"."owner_user_id")
    OR ("smartlingo_media_assets"."kind" IN ('course_cover', 'courseware', 'assignment_attachment') AND "smartlingo_media_assets"."scope_type" = 'language_class')
    OR ("smartlingo_media_assets"."kind" = 'chat_attachment' AND "smartlingo_media_assets"."scope_type" = 'message_thread')
  )
